notes.title: Unholy’s demo is now updated
notes.content:
Dear players, 

Today is the scariest night of the year, so we decided to celebrate it with you by [b]fully updating the Unholy’s demo to the most recent patch released[/b]. It is now able to better reflect the many improvements done so far. 

If you haven't entered the many realities of Dorothea’s journey yet, [b]now you can have a taste of this experience in its most recent state of update[/b]. 

We hope you will have fun, we wish you an unforgettable Halloween, and, as always, thank you all for your support.

notes.title: Patch 1.3 is out now
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32241287/1ad37831a6393f9f33f819c7702cefa6aff224ce.jpg[/img]

Dear players, 

Patch 1.3 is now live and ready to improve several aspects of Unholy’s experience. 

Let’s see together all the improvements available right now: 

[list]
[*] After being chased and hiding in the locker Dorothea will be executed by the enemy (Guards, Plagueman, Hunters)  
[*] Adding mouse smoothing option in the menu  
[*] Collision fixes in Inner Monastery main compound  
[*] Sister no longer should block Guards from passing her  
[*] Fix for navigation in the administration building on the Priest Plaza Level  
[*] Improved system to check if the enemy went out of the navmesh  
[*] Fix for restoring blocker in the Church Complex library  
[*] Better player noticing for the AI in very dark areas  
[*] Various tweaks and improvements to sounds 
[/list]

We hope those fixes and improvements can make your own journey to the Eternal City even more unforgettable. 

Thanks for your support!

notes.title: Patch 1.2 is out now
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32241287/ed0e6e8db96c9d9de53db54af6e62ef9e10d4f68.png[/img]

Dear players,

The patch 1.2 for Unholy is live and ready for download. 

Thanks to your feedback, we were able to improve many aspects of Unholy’s gameplay, make several improvements, and fix some of the bugs you reported to us.

The following are all the fixes implemented right now:

[list]
[*] Better pathfinding for Infected and Hunters. This means that the issue where Infected, while chasing the player in the Office, would go to a different floor instead of running towards the player, is resolved.
[*] Securing Vent Spawners from NPC glitching. Sometimes NPCs would abruptly stop exiting the Vent and get stuck inside the wall.
[*] When the player is in a locker, enemies will immediately enter Blind Chase mode instead of running into a wall or staring at the locker.
[*] Restores now trigger a Sensing Reset, so NPCs won't "know" what they knew before.
[*] Infected rotation is precise to the Player. They won't take 45-degree steps four times to turn around 180 degrees, but they will turn 180 degrees precisely towards the Player they are chasing.
[*] Sisters no longer make Guards stuck if they want to pass them. 
[*] Fixed a bug where enemies would not properly exit the vents in the City Hall area in Chapter V
[*] Fixed a bug where Guards could get stuck in certain place in Chapter V Square arena
[*] Fixed a bug where Players could jump over a ladder and avoid the dialogue with trapped citizen in Chapter V Slums
[*] Various improvements to various sounds during the game
[*] Various fixes
[/list]
With all these improvements, we hope to make the experience better for all of you. Let us know what you think. 

Thank you all for your support!

[*] Collision issues in Chapter X

Unholy is about to be released here on Steam in just a few days, and before that we would like to [b]thank you all for the great success of our demo[/b] at this Steam Next Fest.  

In these weeks [b]we received amazing support and participation from tons of people all around the world[/b], and thanks to you we were able to gather lots of important feedback from our demo. Big shout-out to [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=s5kxhjZdjZE][i]Daz Games[/i][/url], [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_gBl3Ldp4g4&feature=youtu.be][i]Zangado[/i][/url], [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zleKjZsl27M][i]MaxMRM[/i][/url], [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=z-0MQYz7Yyc][i]Menos Trece[/i][/url], [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=uAvYhEiV9uk][i]Shirrako[/i][/url], [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1ii-tODiyGI][i]Insym[/i][/url], and the many, many more who express themselves.

We hear you loud and clear, and so [b]we are pushing ourselves to implement lots of technical and performance improvements[/b], as well as additional options like a FOV Slider, UltraWide support, a font-sizer, and more. 

Due to the entity of general improvements and additions, we believe our actual demo is no longer capable to show Unholy as the game it is now, and that’s why we have decided to remove it on July 20 with the release of the game. So – if you still want to have a taste of Unholy’s experience – be quick!

notes.title: Devlog #4 - Behind the Masks
notes.content:
[i]“We all have Masks.

Those who hide their visage behind masks do not do so to avoid shame or harm. The Mask is our only defense against our world. It is a sign of our unwavering devotion and humility. 

We wear Masks, as our Prophet does. We serve him, as he serves us. With Masks we purge ourselves of emotions. With Masks we purge ourselves from Pain and Fear.”[/i]

                                                                                             Words of the Prophet, Psalm of Subjugation




In this Devlog we would like to delve a little deeper into the rules that govern the world of Unholy, and the relationship between Masks and Emotions.

Simply put, the world of Unholy resonates with its inhabitants' emotions, it feeds on them and allows them to materialize. And when the Fear appeared in the hearts of citizens, it began to show in the world. Our Emotions govern our existence, and thus succumbing to fear means that the world will feed off it and let the fear grow.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32241287/4264737e4577893dde4b4b355dcb625bea4052f3.jpg[/img]

How can one exist in such a world? Only through two things - attaining serenity or by wearing a Mask. The former requires work and knowing one self, the other just requires obedience to the words of the Prophet. We can already guess which one was preferred by the governing clergy.

As the world began to change, people who succumbed to their emotions began dying, as their emotions burst from inside. Deadly and unstoppable, these emotions crystalize on the bodies of the dead, giving us a glimpse into what has happened to them.


Devised by the Spring of Immortality, Masks will deprive you of your Fear, Pain… but also joy. Who would you become upon donning such Mask. What would be left of you upon purging all emotions? As all citizens began to wear Masks, a new hierarchy emerged - Warriors donning the Guard Masks, Reverent Nuns and the dreadful Inquisitors. Yet, the meek are granted no powers or status. Their mask is that of servitude. And thus began the age where your Mask not only steals your emotions but defines your role in the world.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32241287/b35f063633387e92ffe070743b55d3298d7cd278.jpg[/img]

In Unholy, the relations between Masks, Emotions and the inhabitants of this world, will define the entire future of this land. Our main protagonist - will also have her own Mask - an unique Ego Mask, that will allow her to retain her former self. This artifact will provide our hero with the ability to copy and mimic other Masks' powers. In order to find her son, she will have to master her own emotions, attain the powers of others and be armed in such a way to conquer her fears, the world… and the Prophet himself.



Emotions shape the world, they can be used against us if we show what really defines us. So the question is, how far will you go to hide your fear, shame or uncertainty. Imagine you are destined to rule over others, would you show your true feelings?

notes.title: Devlog #3 - Quis custodiet ipsos custodes?
notes.content:
[i]	From my hideout I can see the clock on the Bureau of Administration as it strikes midnight. The shadow of the Monastery looks deeper every day. It feels as if I'm never going to escape it. Those around me seem afraid. Overheard whispers: another district devoured by the plague. Those who were lucky enough were eaten alive by the infected and those less fortunate were gathered and cleansed by the sacred of the Spring of the Eternity - the Guards. Lucky few who managed to escape their grip tell tales of inhuman brutality, fanatical devotion to the High Priest and no mercy for anyone touched by the plague. I’ve heard countless testimonies and witnessed it with my own eyes. And with midnight approaching, their patrols begin. No one is safe - friend or foe. And when they take you as the target - nothing will save you or your beloved. [/i]

-	The Dissenter

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32241287/3fd065720907aba134f0b95e4d44148c46c6c7df.jpg[/img]


[h3]Militia Guard[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32241287/520588d64abb636306cfd459bf0a36592bb7cbd6.png[/img]
	Taken from their homes early and raised in military camps, Militias are the most common troops used by the Spring of Eternity to maintain the peace in the City. During their training they are brainwashed to follow every command without hesitation and with religious devotion to the High Priest. Lightly armored and armed with the metal baton are not much of a match for the Plagued but serve their purpose as a riot control troops. Often you can see them looting infected districts and transporting stolen goods to the Black Cathedral. When encountered be sure to avoid eye contact and perform any utilitarian task.


[h3]City Guard[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32241287/71de17bdfd85d4fe313d75547ef67c28e2e2e025.png[/img]
	Those of the Militia that excel in brutality and fanatic devotion to Spring of Eternity are promoted to become City Guards. Going through extreme training and being subject to various rituals, they are transformed into something more than just soldiers - a living weapon. Armed with the electrical baton, full metal armor and mask with air filtering system they are equipped to deal with the most heated situations in the plagued districts. They often patrol in numbers ready to corner unexpected opponent - wether it’s the infected by the plague or innocent citizen who were just there in the wrong time. 


[h3]Inquisitor[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32241287/13605c330ff3abffa904f5d1b00ae89926740b60.png[/img]
	The Inquisitors are the inner circle of the Spring of Eternity. They are the chosen ones by the High Priest and he had a great reason for picking every one of them. Their loyalty is unquestionable and the fear they impose is the tool that  often will stop the riots and protest before they even start. The High Priest sends them to perform tasks of great importance in the City, like purging the districts, or hunting for the most dangerous heretics. Armed with heavy armor and Flame Baton, they are formidable enemies in combat. When encountered you should run and pray for your life. But run far enough because probably  the closest neighborhood will be burned to the ground. 


	And as the Unholy World sometimes reflects our, the Guards can be also met in the Normal World as servants of their Spring of Eternity in there. Maybe not as brutal but with the same devotion at heart they can be as formidable and will not stop at anything. Wherever you will meet them, whether Unholy or the Normal World, avoid them at any cost, as nothing good will come out of it - only suffering and misery. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32241287/378a06be6614309db857a85caa933aec4658ac5f.png[/img]

notes.title: Devlog #2 - Unholy World
notes.content:
Thanks to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/817020/view/2983060917608230663]Devlog #1[/url], you already know more about Unholy's lore (setting, environment). Today, let's have a look at the Unholy World, where you're gonna spend most of your time in the game. Let's try to understand better heroine's situation in this distant, mystical, hostile, and unknown world.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32241287/15c562bcd4fad7d3f72fc6ff57c4413926cac395.png[/img]

As you can see, we're working on the design of locations, residents, and malevolent monsters. Notice every character, plant and building are connected into some kind of cardiovascular system. Shapes of monsters you'll encounter are not random too.

Light and darkness are crucial during your stealth expeditions in the game. Both can be your ally or enemy. If you'll be spotted by hostile creatures, it's not over though. Using various tools and elements of environment, you can cause a lot of trouble to those who want to hurt you. Expect a slightly different armory than in any other game. Unholy problems required Uhnoly solutions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32241287/2dff75565f1a18a872a4f87cd5953b82e1e00ccc.png[/img]

The last but not least challenge you will encounter on your way to save your son it'll be... yourself. Imagine that you're reaching a distant, diseased world, where castes, the patriarchy of High Priest, and hostile creatures are not the only ones of your concerns. At first and at the end, you're looking for your son. What do you think, what will you do to find him? At what cost?

And what's more, what will happen if you will put a priest's mask on your face too many times? Today, you're not gonna solve this problem. But soon, in the game, many inobvious choices need to be done. Whether you like it or not. Whether you save someone or leave high and dry. Whether you're ready or not.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32241287/596eba481e1b3870c4808955087faeaf97c8c769.png[/img]

We hope you like this sneak peek into our worlds and that you are craving more clues and details about the story and mechanics. Soon we will reveal more information.

Stay tuned!
- Duality Games Team

notes.title: Devlog #1 - Beyond our world….
notes.content:
Welcome to our first Unholy devlog after a long time. We know you are all curious about the changes and our progress with the game. With this post, we would like to start a small tradition of posting new materials more often to give you a better feeling of what we’ve been up to. Let's talk about the 3 worlds we will see in the game.

[b]Normal World[/b]

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32241287/9fc748be7a6b19d740a4e48197e5f53823701afb.jpg[/img]

It’s a world that is similar to the one we know. With architecture and style heavily inspired by the communist era in central Europe, it’s a place where we get to learn about our heroine and her struggle. The setting of closed block house apartments is uniquely unsettling in its own way, and that is why we love it so much. But for sure there are some differences between our world and this one, especially the fact that the cult of Spring of Immortality is present and popular among the common people. 

[b]World In Between[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32241287/9dfaa5ab86502160486b43be4828144d56a0312a.jpg[/img]

The World In Between in a world of passage to Unholy. It’s a place that is similar to the Normal World but it's a darker version and more crooked. It’s the place where all the dark thoughts and intentions are shown in flesh. This is the bridge between the worlds and its architecture reflects it. The opportunity to change her past is the only thing our heroine clings to.
This world has its own challenges and guardians, and the Spring of Immortality influences start to show even here. How much time does she have left?

[b]Unholy World[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32241287/09c043ca117e53599d635cd6f47e0653310d5794.jpg[/img]

Promised land, that ends up a false paradise. Infested by plague and ruled by High Priest, it’s not the place where you would want to end up. Even here, in the darkest of places, people try to organize their life and function as a society. The priests rule with an iron fist and use masks to represent their place in society. Shreds of goodwill and humanity can be found, but faint and rare. Brutality, monsters, and unimaginable cruelty now roam these lands. This world is not for the faint-hearted and our heroine will have a hard time surviving it. But she will do everything she can to save those she loves.

We hope you like this sneak peek into our worlds and that you are craving more clues and details about the story and mechanics. Soon we will reveal more information. 

Stay tuned!

Duality Team
